summary.text: Angus Purdy, an independent front of house lead at Little Hat's Italian Market, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 6th District to Johnny Garrett.
He says he ran for Metro Council in 2023.

paragraphs.text: In a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire, Purdy says he spent his childhood on a small farm in Spring Hill and now calls Nashville home. He lists a B.A. in history from Vanderbilt University.
He received 0.6% of the vote to Johnny Garrett's 50.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Angus Purdy: Independent Candidate for Congress, District 6
